ROLE 角色
The leader and face of the brand — our logo's gold orb brought to life. Touri points the whole family toward opportunity and represents the Tourista AR platform itself.
SIGNATURE 标志
Compass-face head (full N/E/S/W rose + needle) topped with the gold orb ring · blue captain's coat with gold buttons & epaulettes · the "g" orb badge on the chest · grey-cuffed navy boots.
PERSONALITY 性格
家族的队长与品牌门面——由Logo金色指南针化身而来。乐观可靠，永远为团队指引机遇的方向。

The Family Look
Rules so every character reads as one team

Navy anchors every character. Each accent color signals a role: Gold=leader/trade (Touri, Bao) · Orange=exploration (Mira) · AR Blue=technology (Lens) · Forest Green=local roots (Zola).

🎩

Silhouette anchor

One bold headpiece each: Touri = compass · Mira = bucket hat · Lens = AR goggles · Bao = captain's cap · Zola = tree canopy.

🧡

One hero object

Each carries one signature object tied to their job — map, crate, AR panel, compass, trust-medallion.

👁️

Simple faces

Small dark eyes + a soft smile. Minimal detail keeps them sticker-friendly and warm.

🎯

The "g" mark

The gold Touri orb appears on every character (badge, cap, medallion) to tie them to the brand.

👢

Chunky proportions

Big head, small body, sturdy navy boots. Rounded and huggable — never sharp.

✏️

Soft hand-drawn line

Slightly sketchy pencil edges with grainy texture — never hard flat vector lines.
